# Thomas Schlaier and James Shannon
Date: 2026-11-25 | Duration: 26.219999313354492m

## Summary
GrowthBook’s interface and structure remain a positive fit, and teaser-module A/B testing in Living Docs worked, but paywall and rec wall implementation is unresolved. A fresh evaluation is comparing GrowthBook with other vendors, focusing on technical integration across a headless Living Docs CMS, six front ends, BigQuery, Statamic, SDKs, and targeting based on user and content attributes. A prior integration attempt failed because development, data science, and third-party front-end teams encountered invalid data, unexplained errors, and unclear expected behavior. A two-to-four-week technical POC will test data delivery, targeting, reliability, timeouts, and expected behavior before an annual commitment. Enterprise support would include hands-on assistance with SDKs, warehouse integration, and attributes, supported through Slack or Teams and weekly calls. The proposed commercial structure is a one-year enterprise contract at $30,000 plus $750 per seat, with five seats initially planned and no extra usage charges.

## Keywords
Dynamic paywalls, A/B testing, GrowthBook Enterprise, Google BigQuery, Headless CMS, Proof of concept
